blocks.text: Capacitors bohat se gharelu aalaat mein use hote hain, jaise bijli ke pankhe, pani ke pump, washing machines, fridge, flashguns, computer keyboards aur touchscreens.

Pankhe ki motor ke starting circuit se capacitor jora jata hai (Fig 16.17). Bijli chalane par capacitor motor ko jamid ragar (static friction) aur rotor ki inertia par qaboo pane mein madad deta hai taake woh chal kar jaldi ghoomne lage. Washing machines, blenders, choppers, grinders aur pani ke pumps ki motors mein bhi capacitors yahi kaam karte hain.

blocks.title: Capacitor motor ko kaise chalata hai
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke capacitor 'izafi taqat deta hai'. Zyada durust yeh hai ke single-phase motor mein running coil aur starting coil hoti hai. Starting coil ke saath series mein capacitor us coil ke current ka waqt (phase) running coil ke muqable khiska deta hai. Phir dono coils ghoomta magnetic field banati hain jo rotor ko ghumata hai; is ke baghair single-phase motor sirf bhinbhinati aur chalti nahi.

Fridge aur air conditioners ke compressors aam taur par single-phase motors use karte hain jo khud chalne mein mushkil mehsoos karti hain, is liye zyada capacitance ke capacitors use hote hain. Aisa 'start capacitor' compressor motor ke liye jump start ki tarah kaam kar ke use ghumata hai; motor khaas raftar tak pohanche to relay use alag kar deta hai. Zyada tar fridge aur air conditioners mein 'run capacitor' bhi hota hai jo tawanai ki kaarkardagi barhane ke liye jura rehta hai, agarche kuch purane model sirf start capacitors rakhte hain. Capacitors resistors ke saath time-delay circuits bhi banate hain, jo fridge, air conditioners aur doosre aalaat mein bijli chalane mein der ke liye use hote hain, aur unhein bijli ke utaar charhao se bachate hain (Fig 16.18, compressor ki tasveer, shamil nahi).

Flashgun mein capacitor flash tube ko chalane ke liye bijli ki tawanai jama aur kharij karta hai; tube mein xenon gas hoti hai. Capacitor camera ki battery se charge hota hai. Shutter button dabane par capacitor flash tube se jur jata hai, aur us ka tez discharge xenon ko ionise karne ke liye zaruri zyada current deta hai, jis se roshni ka tez jhonka nikalta hai (Fig 16.19 camera ki tasveer hai).

Capacitors rectification mein, yani alternating current (AC) ko direct current (DC) mein badalne mein, wasee taur par use hote hain; bridge circuit naam ka full-wave rectifier aam misal hai, aur rectifiers agle chapter mein parhe jayenge. Tibb mein capacitors dil ko jaan bachane wala jhatka dene ke liye zaruri bijli ki tawanai jama karte hain taake dil ka daura parne ke baad aam dharkan bahal ho (defibrillator). Yeh imaging machines (CT, MRI, X-ray, ultrasound) mein shor (noise) chhaant kar tasveer saaf karne, aur EEG aur ECG machines mein na-pasandeeda signals chhaantne mein bhi use hote hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: single-phase motor rotor ke gird coils ke halqe ki shakal mein, supply taarein N aur L aur starting coil ke saath series mein capacitor; note ke capacitor starting coil ke current ka phase khiska kar ghoomta magnetic field banata. Oopar daen: flashgun circuit jis mein battery capacitor charge karti jo switch se xenon tube ke aar-paar jora jata. Neeche daen: rectified pulses (neele, dashed) aur smoothing capacitor ke saath kaheen mustahkam voltage (surkh).
blocks.caption: Capacitors ke kuch istemal (Figs 16.17 se 16.19 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Har aale mein capacitor ya to charge jama kar ke tezi se kharij karta (flash, defibrillator), current ka waqt khiskata (motor), ya pulses ke darmiyan khala bharta (rectifier) hai.

blocks.prompt: Flashgun chhoti battery se bohat tez flash kaise paida kar sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Battery capacitor ko ahista ahista charge karti hai; phir capacitor apni tamam jama tawanai bohat kam waqt mein kharij karta, jis se flash tube mein bohat zyada current aur taqat milti hai.

items: Motors (pankhe, pump, compressor): start aur run capacitors.
Tibb: defibrillators, imaging, EEG aur ECG filtering.
